31633f4.summary: Estimates how much damage a DamageCriteria will deal. Depending on its value option it reads a card's attack, health, damage taken or bastion; otherwise it returns the rounded mean of min and max. Used when the AI/UI needs a preview number; changes no state.
comments: Read the configured value mode and the fixed min/max damage numbers.
Mode below 0x2a: stat modes that read a card's attack, health or damage taken.
Mode: target's melee attack (also reached for ThisCardAttack via the shared label below).
Shared melee path: total the buffs on the card, then add its base melee attack.
A stat-adding buff contributes its melee bonus to the running total.
A 'set melee attack' buff overrides everything, so its value is returned immediately.
Base melee plus buff total, clamped to 0 (the shift/xor trick is max(x,0)).
Mode: target's ranged attack (also used for ThisCardAttackRanged).
A blind unit has no ranged attack; this path ends up returning 0 (enum Normal is 0).
Same as melee: ranged bonuses from stat buffs add up, a set-ranged-attack buff overrides.
Base ranged attack plus buff total, clamped to 0.
Mode: target's current health.
ThisCardAttack/ThisCardAttackRanged: reuse the target code but on the card that owns the ability.
Modes 0x2a-0x46: this card's health and 'damage taken' modes.
Target damage taken = max health minus current health.
ThisCardDamage: same calculation on the source card.
Modes 0x47-0x96: scaled-by-multiplier mode (0x50) and target bastion (0x96).
Mode 0x50: base plus multiplierFactor times the max value (decompiler lost part of this).
Modes 0x97 and up: self bastion and 'target health minus attack'.
Bastion total: sum bastion-trait buffs from active effects plus the card's own bastion value.
Bastion result clamped to 0.
Target health minus its current melee attack.
No special mode: average of min and max, rounded half to even (Math.Round style).

3163544.summary: Makes a shallow copy of a SummonCriteria and returns it as a SummonCriteria. Called when an ability's criteria must be duplicated so edits do not affect the original.
comments: Shallow-clone this criteria object.
Decompiler inlined the type cast check here (and a bogus Monitor.Exit); the result is the clone cast to SummonCriteria.

3163790.summary: Unity OnEnable: caches the transform and records its current position as the last-seen position, so the first Update has a baseline for measuring motion.
comments: Cache the transform for cheap access in Update.
Store the starting position as lastPosition.

31637e0.summary: Per-frame update that tilts a card in the direction it is moving, then eases it back to flat shortly after it stops. Changes the card's local rotation and lastPosition.
comments: Has the transform moved since last reset? If not and the settle timer has run out, nothing to do.
Card moved: restart the 'keep tilting after movement' timer.
Tick the settle timer down by frame time.
Movement since last frame on each axis becomes a clamped tilt angle (see GetRotation).
Decompiler turned the quaternion multiply into raw NEON vector ops; it combines the X and Y tilts into targetRotation.
Blend the card's local rotation toward the target tilt.
Remember this frame's position for the next frame's movement delta.
Null-reference fallthrough from the decompiler.

3163a94.summary: Converts a movement amount along one axis into a rotation quaternion, with the angle clamped to plus or minus the max angle. Helper for AutoCardRotation.Update; the decompiler garbled its parameters.
comments: Scale movement into an angle (decompiler garbled this; seems to be translation times a factor).
Clamp the angle to the allowed range on both sides.
Build a rotation of that angle around the axis.
Quaternion multiply with identity written into the output struct (decompiler shows it as raw offsets).

3256cb8.summary: Coroutine body for SetChangedAmountTextUp: waits one WaitForEndOfFrame and then ends. Runs after a card's stat-change text is set.
comments: First step: yield and wait until the end of the frame.
Second step: resume and finish the coroutine.

3256d54.summary: Compiler-generated IEnumerator.Reset for the SetChangedAmountTextUp coroutine; always throws NotSupportedException.
comments: Coroutines cannot be reset, so this always throws.

3163d8c.summary: Unity OnEnable: re-registers the CardClicked handler on the card's click catcher, but only if tap-to-open card display is allowed.
comments: If there is a click catcher, first remove any existing CardClicked listener to avoid duplicates.
Tap-to-open disabled: leave without re-adding.
Add the CardClicked listener again.
Decompiler inlined UnityEvent.AddListener (list append plus resize); the effect is just adding the listener.

3163e94.summary: Click handler: opens the card display window showing this card's raw data at its tier.
comments: Open the shared card detail window for this card and tier.

3163f28.summary: Unity OnDisable: removes the CardClicked handler from the click event so a hidden card cannot open the card window.
comments: If there is a click catcher, remove our listener from its click event.
Decompiler inlined UnityEvent.RemoveListener: collect matching calls into a list, then remove them.
Delete the matching calls and rebuild the combined call list.

3163fb8.summary: Fills a BasicCardUI from raw card data: tier, texts, armour, health, attacks and cost, shows or hides each counter by card type, and sets art and rarity stars. Used for collection, deck and tooltip card views.
comments: Hide the 'new card' badge.
No tier supplied: use the card's own tier.
Warlord (hero-like) cards do not show a mana cost.
Set name, description, race and army texts.
Only hero cards get the warlord health modifier.
No override: show the card's own max health plus modifier.
Max health override given (e.g. upgraded warlord): use it instead.
Fill attack and cost counters.
Cost shows only if not a warlord and mana cost is non-negative (sign bit clear).
Update tier decoration.
Only unit cards show health and attack counters.
Armour shows only for units that actually have armour.
Clear the banned marker, then set art and rarity stars.

31645f4.summary: Shows or hides all stat counters (health, armour, melee, ranged, cost) on the card UI.
comments: Show: reset the hide state on each counter.
Cost counter is just un-hidden.
Hide: hide each stat counter; armour is also toggled off.
Cost counter: mark hidden, reset amount and blank its texts.

3164524.summary: Sets the card art from the raw card data's sprite: positions and scales the image for the card type, applies a mask, makes a per-card material instance, and assigns the sprite to the Image.
comments: Need a raw card with an art sprite, otherwise nothing to do.
Card type decides scale and mask.
Position of -1111 is a 'not saved yet' marker: record the image's original position the first time.
Apply the per-card-type scale.
Big-frame heroes and minions get an extra size multiplier.
Tactic cards: no alpha mask and an offset position.
Other cards: the sprite texture doubles as the alpha mask.
Move image to original position plus type offset.
Create an instanced material once so shared material is not changed.
Decompiler inlined Image.sprite setter: swaps the sprite and marks the Image dirty when it changed.

3164938.summary: Called after a language change: refreshes the card's localized name, description, race and army texts and re-picks the name/description layout. Decompiler output is heavily tangled here.
comments: Log which card is being updated.
Fetch the localized name, description, race and army strings.
Tell the text controller the card and spell type, then fill the text fields.
No name texts: set race, description and army directly.
Write the localized name into every name text.
Decompiler fused the inlined helpers (SetRace, SetDescription, SetArmy, layout) with fake stack code; the calls are right.
Write race into all race texts.
Write description into all description texts.
Write army into all army texts.
Choose starting layout: 1 minion with text, 2 no description, 3/4 for tactics and whispers.
Switch to the layout state if not already in it.
Tactics pick 3 (normal spell) or 4; others pick 1 with description or 2 without.
